falsification_conditions.condition: S&P 500 closes above 5,600 on any day in the next 14 days
falsification_conditions.what_it_would_mean: The bottom_2024_aug pattern requires lower highs and failed rallies; a close above 5,600 breaks the descending resistance structure and invalidates the bearish bottoming pattern, suggesting accumulation rather than distribution

falsification_conditions.condition: VIX closes below 14.00 for 3 consecutive days
falsification_conditions.what_it_would_mean: A sustained VIX compression below 14 would signal complacency returning and fear dissipating, directly contradicting the capitulation dynamics typical of the bottom_2024_aug pattern where volatility remains elevated during base formation

falsification_conditions.condition: 10Y Treasury yield drops below 3.80% while S&P 500 simultaneously rises more than 2% from current levels
falsification_conditions.what_it_would_mean: This would indicate a goldilocks/soft-landing repricing rather than recessionary bottoming; the bottom_2024_aug pattern featured yields falling with stocks on recession fear, not yields falling with stocks rallying on growth optimism

doctrine: If you can't list what would prove your call wrong, you don't have a real call.
